title: Bourbon Explained
description: A short introductory masterclass for bartenders, hospitality newcomers and anyone into whiskey: bourbon's history, how it's made and how ageing shapes its character. About 1 to 2 hours, with a certificate on completion.
topics: The legal rules that define bourbon
How bourbon became America's national spirit
Production, from grain to barrel-aged spirit
Fun facts and insider knowledge for hospitality
